articles.title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
articles.description: Iraq removes a military commander and opens investigations into the attack that came from an area bordering Iran.

articles.title: Ukraine faces 'toughest winter' since Russia's full-scale invasion, UN official tells BBC
articles.description: A senior UN official tells the BBC there is a race against the clock to ensure access to power and water through winter.

articles.title: Only Roland Garros towel left, says Ukraine tennis player after Russian strike hits flat
articles.description: Dayana Yastremska says her flat took a "direct hit" by a Russian missile in Odesa, and all that left was her Roland Garros towel.

articles.title: Lightning Houthi advance in Yemen may bring dangerous new dimension to Iran war
articles.description: The capture by the rebels of a stretch of Yemen's strategic coastline is the group's most impressive military coup for several years.

articles.title: Firefighters say this antioxidant helped them - their union warns it could be risky
articles.description: Glutathione, an antioxidant, has been offered as a treatment at some of the largest US wildfires in recent years.

articles.title: Israel strike on Hezbollah tunnel triggers earthquake-like tremor
articles.description: Israel has destroyed a network of Hezbollah tunnels in southern Lebanon - triggering a 4.1 magnitude tremor in the area.

articles.title: Half a million Russians killed in Ukraine war, British intelligence says
articles.description: Half a million Russian soldiers have been killed in Vladimir Putin's full-scale war against Ukraine, according to British military intelligence.
